user.title: Magic Links
user.description: Set how unauthenticated links behave. You can change everything later from “Configure”.

data_description.external_url: Public Home Assistant address used to build links (e.g. https://home.example.com). If empty, HA's external URL is used.
data_description.confirm_page: Show a “Confirm” button before running. If disabled, opening the link runs the action immediately: WhatsApp/Telegram previews may trigger it by themselves.
data_description.max_fails: After this many wrong tokens, the IP address is temporarily blocked.
data_description.fail_window: Minutes over which failed attempts are counted.
data_description.show_sidebar: If disabled, the dashboard stays reachable at /magic-links.

error.invalid_url: Invalid URL (must start with http:// or https://)

abort.single_instance_allowed: Magic Links is already set up
